scoring_justification: DFT calculations are compute-intensive and cannot be rerun in the verifier; compare reported quantities to paper values with tolerances and structural checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold magnetic moments for Co_Ti and Co_Ti+V_O defects
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.4 and text: Co_Ti^0 0.93 μB, Co_Ti^{2-} 0.99 μB, (Co_Ti+V_O)^{2+} 1.89 μB, (Co_Ti+V_O)^0 0.95 μB

formation_energies.description: Keys: defect labels (e.g. Co_Ti, Co_int, V_O, Ti_int, Co_Ti+V_O). Values: objects mapping charge state (e.g. 0, +2, -2) to formation energy in eV.

magnetic_moments.description: Keys: defect labels. Values: objects mapping charge state to spin magnetic moment in μB.

pair_energies.description: Keys: pair type labels (e.g. Co_Ti-Co_Ti_neutral, Co_Ti-Co_Ti_charged). Values: objects mapping separation distance (in Å) to relative total energy in eV.

FM_AFM_difference.description: Keys: pair type labels. Values: energy difference (E_FM - E_AFM) in eV.

outputs.description: Contains the reproduced defect formation energies, magnetic moments, pair interaction energies, and FM-AFM energy differences for Co-doped TiO2, as computed by the agent's DFT+U workflow.
